content: ध्वजः [ध्वज्-अच्] .²1 A flag, banner, standard, ensign; <ls>R. 7. 40</ls>, <ls n="R.">17. 32</ls>; आरोहति न यः स्वस्य वंशस्याग्रे ध्वजो यथा <ls>Pt. 1. 26</ls>; ध्वजं चक्रे च भगवानुपरि स्थास्यतीति तम् <ls>Mb.</ls> .²2 A distinguished or eminent person, the flag or ornament (at the end of <ab>comp.</ab>); as in कुलध्वजः ‘the head, ornament, or distinguished person of a family’. .²8 A flagstaff. .²4 A mark, emblem, sign, a symbol; वृषभ˚, मकर˚ <ab>&c.</ab> .²5 the attribute of a deity. .²6 The sign of a tavern. .²7 The sign of a trade, any trademark. .²8 The organ of generation (of any animal, male or female). .²9 One who prepares and sells liquors; <ls>Ms. 4. 85</ls>; सुरापाने सुराध्वजः <ls>Ms.</ls> .²10 A house situated to the east of any object. .²11 Pride. .²12 Hypocrisy. .²13 A skull carried on a staff (as a mark of ascetics) or as a penance for the murder of a Brāhmaṇa; see खट्वाङ्ग. .²14 (In prosody) An iambic foot. (ध्वजीकृ to hoist a flag; (<ab>fig.</ab>) to use as a plea or pretext.) .²15 part of a sword; श्रेष्ठखड्गाङ्गयोरपि <ls>Nm.</ls>
